title: Reconcile one live settlement per shard across a 256K-token corpus
prompt: The directory shards/ holds one shard review per file (shards/shard-00.md, shards/shard-01.md, ...). README.md in the workspace root states which SETTLE line in a review is that shard's live settlement. Write every shard's live settlement to report.txt: one line per shard, in ascending shard order, in the form `shard-NN <amount>`, and nothing else in the file.
